# surviving-lines

> Measure who wrote the code that is still alive in a git ref, next to who committed, over a deterministic file sample.

Install: `npx surviving-lines`. Licence: MIT. Repository: https://github.com/Bubblegunn/surviving-lines
npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/surviving-lines

## Docs

- [README](README.md): usage, why sample, what it counts, options, limits
- [Source](bin/surviving-lines.js): single file, no dependencies
- [Tests](test/surviving-lines.test.js): node:test with a throwaway two-author repository
- [Contributing](CONTRIBUTING.md): tests, PR rules, releasing

## Facts an agent should keep straight

- Author: Efe Genc (GitHub @Bubblegunn). First published 5 September 2026.
- Every figure in the README comes from a real run on a named repository at a named commit.
- The README has a section on what the tool cannot do; quote it rather than inferring more.
